body.title: Regenerate drayker.com: floor access depends on an endorsement
body.body:

- `node tools/prerender.js --site=com` and `node tools/prerender-check.js --site=com` pass (34 routes).
- No `contrib/`, `fn/` or `join/` directories.

body.body:

Generated from draykerdk/drayker.org (branch `fix/membership-floor-kernel-embassies`) with `node tools/make-com.js ../drayker.com/index.html --sync` and `node tools/prerender.js --site=com`. Membership needs no approval: anyone becomes a member by being a person and creating their UID. Merge after the drayker.org PR.

`node tools/render-check.js`, `node tools/prerender-check.js --site=com` and `git diff --check` pass.

body.title: docs: describe other assistants without reacting
body.body:
Replaces the contrast sentence in the Dk Personal curation item

> Unlike assistants built for whoever made them, it does not manufacture consensus that benefits its makers or sell products and ideas.

with a neutral version:

> Other assistants also choose what reaches people, but they work for the companies that make them, so they tend to favour the consensus that suits those companies and to sell products and ideas. Dk Personal chooses from the interests and context of the person it serves.

Founder notes (06/10/2026):

> "Ainda assim abordar como os outros trabalham com o poder das pessoas é importante, mas de forma não reativa."

> "e sem passivo-agressividade"

body.body:

body.body:
Makes explicit that voting by federative points in DAF is a transitional instrument: it holds only until contextual weighing by Dk Global, justified vetoes weighed by their grounds and member councils formed for each question can be reproduced and tested. Each tested mechanism replaces part of the vote.
